problem_statement:

CREATE TABLE t1 (a INT);
LOCK TABLE t1 WRITE;

--error ER_TABLE_NOT_LOCKED
REVOKE EXECUTE ON PROCEDURE sp FROM u;

# Cleanup
DROP TABLE t1;
{code}
